subject: proj
title: PROJ.------COS.P.
description: Diagram in CMBA-12. (C)PROJ (projection) is crossed with COS-P (cosmic particulars): the question is what projection requires of cosmic-particulars. PROJ branches to MTA-RT-SIGN (meta-reality significance) → ACT (activism), and to A-PR (all-purpose). A-PR branches to MT-DEVF (multiple diversification) and to TR (transformation) → INFO-DY (information dynamics). INFO-DY branches to INFO-ALGN (information alignment) and to DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) → OP-SPD (option spread) → INDIV-DY (individual dynamics). The transformation → information-dynamics → dynamic-functionalism → option-spread chain registers how transformation produces the option spread Braxton named in CMBA-11 as the structural shape of 1960s alternative routes.
